speaker: Elder Patrick Kearon
title: Jesus Lives to Lift
session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

points.text: Elder Patrick Kearon spoke about “Jesus Lives to Lift”.

quotes.text: I spent much of my childhood at boarding school in England looking up at aeroplanes crossing the sky, dreaming of flying home to my parents thousands of miles away in Arabia. I yearned to fly! I wanted to become a fighter pilot.
quotes.speaker: Elder Patrick Kearon
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: The crucial skill in gliding is finding rising air. You cannot see it, but you can see what it does. I was taught to look for cumulus clouds because they often mark where warm air is rising, and I learned to fly toward them.
quotes.speaker: Elder Patrick Kearon
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: I was taught how to stay in lift, circling upward to gain altitude, and to often join other pilots who had found lift, climbing with them in the same invisible column of rising air.
quotes.speaker: Elder Patrick Kearon
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: A decade after those gliding days, and not far into my journey of faith, I recognised that the principles of gliding I had learned in my teens have significant similarities with spiritual principles: We must avoid sink and find lift.
quotes.speaker: Elder Patrick Kearon
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Through the amazing grace of Jesus Christ, we can avoid spiritual sink and find spiritual lift. Spiritual lift cannot be seen, but as we learn to discern and act upon the sensitive impressions of the Holy Spirit, we can feel it—as surely as I felt the rising air lift a wing beneath me.
quotes.speaker: Elder Patrick Kearon
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Can you identify moments when you have felt undeniable spiritual lift? Where were you? How did it feel? Isn’t it magnificent to feel like you are being drawn upward, rising higher and higher toward your Heavenly Father and your intended eternal potential?
quotes.speaker: Elder Patrick Kearon
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Isn’t it the same in our lives? How easy it is to slowly slip from spiritual heights we have worked so hard to climb when we neglect the practices and behaviours that brought us there. We rarely intend to sink. We want lift—its joy and blessings—but we may not recognise the quiet cost of neglecting vital communion with our Father, Saviour, and the Holy Spirit.
quotes.speaker: Elder Patrick Kearon
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Ammon cannot begin to describe this profound transition from devastating sink to the most glorious lift. And I haven’t met anyone who can. The language of the Spirit of God is not a language of words.
quotes.speaker: Elder Patrick Kearon
quotes.session: Saturday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference
